Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: Hi, Yasha! Here you can sharpen your flying skills with the Tallit. Don't worry, it's not hard at all, and it's really fun! If you need help, I'm here for you.
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene1.text2: Press the jump button again while in the air to open the Tallit. Keep holding the jump button to glide!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene1.text4: Don’t worry if you don't get it right away – you can try again! And again, and again, until you fly like a true superhero!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene2.text2: By the way, if you try to glide for too long, the Tallit will close.
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene2.text3: There's a perfect spot for flying nearby: See if you can reach all the way to that edge! Don’t worry if you don’t make it, you can always come back and try again!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene3.text1: Great! You're learning quickly! You can also use geyser air currents to reach higher places with the Tallit – Watch this!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene3.text2: Woohoo! Just like that, give it a try yourself!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene4.text1: Awesome, remember, you can glide and fly in different directions with the Tallit. Try to reach the next platform. I'll be waiting for you there!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene5.text1: Well done! Now, you can easily use the Tallit on your journey!
Tutorial1_dialogue.cutscene5.text2: It's like a secret weapon to help you overcome any obstacle and explore the farthest reaches of this magical world.
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: Did you know that your hat has incredible abilities? By pressing the throw button again, you can teleport to where it flies.
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene1.text2: I've prepared special challenges for you. Completing them will test your agility and teleportation skills.
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene1.text3: And you'll earn valuable crystals as a reward!
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene1.text4: If you fail the first time, don't worry! Try again, and success will come. Your reward will be waiting for you, safe and sound.
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene1.text5: The rules are simple: you need to aim slightly, launch the hat, wait for it to reach where you want to teleport and press the throw button again.
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene2.text1: You did great! Now you’re a master of teleportation!
Tutorial2_dialogue.cutscene2.text2: In the future, be careful when throwing your hat so you don't accidentally teleport to a place you didn't expect.
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: Hi, Yasha! Ready for a new adventure? Let's combine what you've learned. You can use the Tallit and Hat Teleportation together!
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene1.text2: It might seem tricky, but don't be afraid. I know you can handle it!
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene1.text3: Try to cross this chasm. Fly part of the way with the Tallit, and when it's about to close, throw your hat and teleport to the other side! Go on, you can do it!
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene2.text1: Great job! Now let's practice overcoming obstacles.
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene3.text1: You'll need all your skills here: these moving platforms are far apart. But by using the Tallit and then teleporting with your Hat, you can reach them.
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene3.text2: Try to predict the platform's movement and jump. If you don't make it, try again. I believe in you!
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene4.text1: Oh, a wall! I'll show you how to get past it. Use the Tallit, then when you're past the wall, throw your hat to the platform.
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene4.text2: Watch this, and don't say you didn't see it! Here goes…
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene4.text3: Just like that! Now, give it a try yourself!
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene5.text1: You're doing great! I knew you could do it! It's time to get back to our adventure and apply all your skills.
Tutorial3_dialogue.cutscene5.text2: Now that you're a true professional, we can conquer any peak and overcome any challenge.
dialogue.cutscene6.text7.3\n: Try to absorb these lessons and apply them in your future adventures.
dialogue.cutscene6.text7.2: Gather wisdom: in every journey, there will be lessons and knowledge that will make you wiser.
dialogue.cutscene6.text7.1\n\n: Respect for others will help you make new friends and allies.
dialogue.cutscene6.text7\n: When meeting different characters, learn from them about their culture and traditions.
dialogue.cutscene6.text6.3\n\n: If you encounter difficulties, don't despair; instead, seek new paths and solutions.
dialogue.cutscene6.text6.2\n\n: Be patient: journeys through different worlds can be challenging, but remember that perseverance is the key to success.
dialogue.cutscene6.text6.1\n: Explore every corner, interact with characters, and search for hidden items — this will help you unlock new possibilities and solve puzzles.
dialogue.cutscene6.text6\n: Explore the world around you. The Hub and its portals hold many mysteries and secrets.
dialogue.cutscene6.text5: Now I'll give you some tips for the game:
dialogue.cutscene6.text4\n: Are you ready for an exciting adventure? Don't forget your Magic Hat and Tallit!
dialogue.cutscene6.text3: It's like a control center for a magical world, but even more fascinating!
dialogue.cutscene6.text2: Here, you can explore various epochs and discover objects that will help you on your journey.
dialogue.cutscene6.text1: Welcome to the Hub, the heart of the Secret Room - the place where the paths of time and space converge!
dialogue.cutscene5.text3: Memorize the path, like the ancient sages memorized their knowledge, and together, we'll solve this puzzle! Your wisdom and attention are the keys to success.
dialogue.cutscene5.text2: Remember, when the light of the lamps fades, the bridges will play hide-and-seek with us again.
dialogue.cutscene5.text1:
Oh, Rabbiman, welcome
to the <color=#FF6700>Puzzle of Vanishing Bridges</color>!
dialogue.cutscene4.text2: The bridge will still be under you when the lamps go out. It's invisible, but it's there! Just imagine yourself walking on it like clouds!
dialogue.cutscene4.text1: Wow! Ahead of us, there's a bridge stuck in time! Do you see these magical lamps? They emit a special light that makes the bridge visible.
dialogue.cutscene3.text2: Your Hat holds an extraordinary power and will be very helpful on your journey. Use it wisely… Onward!
dialogue.cutscene3.text1: You've done a great job, and our path forward is now open!
dialogue.cutscene2.text2\n: By the way, your hat looks fantastic! Try <color=#FF6700>tossing it onto the lever</color> to activate the mechanism.
dialogue.cutscene2.text1: Do you see this <color=#FF6700>lever</color>? It's a good thing you brought your hat.
dialogue.cutscene1.text3: I sense disturbances in time, but I don't understand where they're coming from. Let's move forward, and I'll show you what I've discovered so far.
dialogue.cutscene1.text2: Something strange is happening in the Secret Room...
dialogue.HUB.cutscene2.text2\n: Look! We’re detecting something dangerous in the Great Forest! That’s where your brother and sister went for the Tu BiShvat celebration — the New Year of the Trees!
dialogue.HUB.cutscene2.text1\n: Now, let's go ahead and use the magic portal to scan reality and understand where the strange signals are coming from.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level1.cutscene1.text: Here we are in the Great Forest, and the locals are already preparing for the celebration.
Tu BiShvat is the New Year of the Trees. As we celebrate it, we reflect on how to better ourselves and the world, drawing inspiration from trees, for man is like the tree of the field.
Let's move forward and look around; maybe Dina and Dania are nearby.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level1.cutscene2.text: It's very strange... The forest residents are so hostile and trying to hinder us!
I've visited these places many times and I’ve never seen anything like this. It’s like they’ve been possessed by a spirit of foolishness.
Let's find out what happened to them while we search for your sister and brother.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level2.cutscene1.text: Look, these places are drying up for some reason. Let's quickly <color=#FF6700>nourish them with dew</color> and save the plants.
It seems that someone is deliberately drying the soil and trying to ruin the New Year of the Trees for the forest inhabitants.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level2.cutscene2.text: I'm so glad to see you! I couldn't have done it without you.
Something strange is happening in the forest: some areas are drying up, and the forest inhabitants have suddenly turned against us. I've lost Dina, and we must find her!
Don't worry, we'll follow your sister and find her. In the meantime, it will be safer for you to wait for us in the Hub.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level3.cutscene1.text: We found your sister, Dina! How wonderful!
Yasha, it's so good that you showed up. I was completely lost.
I think what's happening in the forest is the work of the Evil Inclination — the Yetzer Hara. We need to be careful.
Then it would be best for you to wait in the Hub with Dania. We'll find out who is trying to ruin Tu BiShvat and stop them.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level4.cutscene1.text: Although these plants look completely lifeless, their roots are hidden from us. They nourish them and have helped them survive this drought.
A person is like a tree, and their roots are their family and traditions.If you nourish the roots, the person grows to be whole, harmonious, and happy.
Nurture your roots like the roots of a strong tree.
dialogue.TuBiShvat.Level5.cutscene1.text: Dina was right — it's the tricks of the Evil Inclination.
He has sent a spirit of foolishness into the animals to hinder us, and he is drying out the forest, trying to ruin the celebration.
But as the ancient books says, it is true: "Better is a poor but wise youth than an old but foolish king who no longer knows how to take a warning".
Ha ha! You won't catch me or stop my tricks!
Let him go. If he causes trouble again, our portal will detect him immediately, no matter where he hides.
Hanukkah1_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: It feels like the times of Hanukkah... But I'm not sure. We should climb higher. Perhaps from there, we can get a better view of the surroundings.
Hanukkah1_dialogue.cutscene4.text1: Looks like these dungeons are overrun by evil darkness. But remember, even a small light is enough to dispel great darkness.
Hanukkah1_dialogue.cutscene4.text2: You can activate <color=#FF6700>the lens</color> using your hat.
Hanukkah1_dialogue.cutscene6.text1: Be careful, Rabbiman! These wooden floorings seem unreliable; be ready to jump <color=#FF6700>before they collapse</color>.
Hanukkah1_dialogue.cutscene7.text1: Use this <color=#FF6700>reflector</color>. You can spin it and redirect the beam of light from the lens to dispel the darkness.
Hanukkah2_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: Look, Yasha - it's the real Maccabee, one of the brave warriors who fought against the Greeks.
Hanukkah2_dialogue.cutscene1.text2: The Greeks have taken over these lands, putting up idols and stopping us from following our traditions. We've risen up and are fighting back!
Hanukkah2_dialogue.cutscene1.text3: These lands are filled with Greek guards, and I need to pass a letter to another unit. I need someone as small and agile as you to carry it unnoticed.
Hanukkah2_dialogue.cutscene1.text4: Be careful and avoid <color=#FF6700>the torchlight</color> of the guards, or they'll spot you and capture you.
Hanukkah2_dialogue.cutscene3.text1: Thank you, brave boy. This letter will be a great help to us, but I must hurry now. Good luck on your journey!
Hanukkah3_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: We cannot stand aside while the brave Maccabees reclaim the holy places. We will assist them and cleanse these dungeons from the evil darkness.
Hanukkah5_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: We are still in the midst of the battle, and our small unit is overcoming the vast Greek army, but your help would be most welcome.
Hanukkah5_dialogue.cutscene1.text2: <color=#FF6700>The key to the gate</color> is hidden in these dungeons. Find it so we can move forward.
Hanukkah5_dialogue.cutscene2.text1: Thank you, Yasha - you've been a great help and left your mark on history. It's no wonder you bear the proud name Rabbiman.
Hanukkah6_dialogue.cutscene1.text1: Be ready, Rabbiman, we've finally caught up with the Evil Inclination, that old foolish King, and now we can prevent him from doing evil in these places and drive him away.
Hanukkah6_dialogue.cutscene2.text1: As I've always said, Yasha! Light always triumphs over darkness. We've managed to cleanse these dungeons from the evil darkness!
Hanukkah6_dialogue.cutscene3.text1: Just look, Yasha, it's that same little cruse of oil. While we were fighting the darkness, a small army of Maccabees defeated the Greeks and purified the temple!
Hanukkah6_dialogue.cutscene3.text2: Hooray!Now we are witnessing a true Hanukkah miracle, Yasha. The oil in this cruse was only enough for one day, but it burned for a full eight days!
Hanukkah6_dialogue.cutscene3.text3\n\n\n: In memory of this miracle, Jews celebrate Hanukkah for eight days every year.
dialogue.HUB.cutscene3.text1: Shabbat is about to begin, and I was hoping to spend it with you. But the candles, kiddush cup, and even the challah have all disappeared from the Hub.
dialogue.HUB.cutscene3.text2: I think it's the tricks of the Evil Inclination, and he wants to stop us from celebrating Shabbat. Let's use the portal, find him, and get back everything we need for Shabbat!
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level1.cutscene1.tex: I sense the presence of the <color=#FF6700>candles</color> in this place. Let's find them!
But be careful, the Evil Inclination has filled the Secret Room with phantoms and time vortices that will try to lead you astray.
Sometimes he will create illusions, hiding real platforms and creating fake ones.
But the <color=#FF6700>light of the candles</color> will always show you where reality is hidden.
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level1.cutscene2.tex: There he is again — the old foolish King. He sees how well you are doing and wants to stop you from fulfilling the blessing of Shabbat.
The Evil Inclination is manipulating time and can transport you to the recent past if you get caught in his beam.
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level1.cutscene3.tex: Great, you got our candles back! If they can reveal reality even now, imagine their power during Shabbat!
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level2.cutscene1.tex: Hurry! We're on our way to the Kiddush cup! With it, we can say the blessing over the juice and welcome the Shabbat.
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level2.cutscene2.tex: Well done, you found the Kiddush cup! the Evil Inclination couldn't lead you astray!
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level3.cutscene1.tex: Now all we have to do is find the Challahs. I think I can smell their aroma even from here!
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level3.cutscene2.tex: How fresh they are! They will be very useful to us. Challahs are an integral part of Shabbat.
These are no longer innocent pranks — trying to disrupt Shabbat? Yetzer Hara has gone too far with his mischief.
But I know something that can make even a hardened, sinful soul want to return to the Almighty— the sound of the shofar.
Though it won't be easy to reach it, we can try to find it and awaken the good in the heart of the Evil Inclination.
dialogue.SecretRoom.Level4.cutscene1.tex: The path to the shofar passes through the entire Secret Room. There's a "platform" that travels on ancient magical tracks. It will take you straight to your destination!
Here we are, at the shofar! Sound it, and its call will surely awaken goodness in the heart of the Evil Inclination.
No matter how deeply he may hide it, goodness resides in everyone's heart.
Did you think you could stop me? You won't succeed! Look how huge and strong I am!
Yes, you may be huge, but it's just your inflated pride. True strength is always hidden within!
Hurry, Yasha, the shofar — our last hope! You can reach it before him!
This sound is like children calling to their father.
Hearing it, I suddenly woke up and realized all the horrible things I had done. I don’t want to be evil anymore!
This is what the sounds of the shofar can do! They penetrate deep into the heart and ignite a fire of goodness within it.
We shouldn't destroy evil; we should transform it. In the end, it can become a source of great light.
And now, let's all hurry to Shabbat together!
Final.cutscene1.text1: It was an unforgettable adventure! And you – you are truly brave!
Final.cutscene1.text2: You found the brother and sister, saved the magical forest from drought, helped the courageous Maccabees, returned the sacred Sabbath set, and, most importantly – turned darkness into light.
Final.cutscene1.text3: You helped our friend free himself from the evil within and let goodness back into his heart! Hooray!
Final.cutscene1.text4: Don't leave too soon! Many fun activities still await you here in the magical world of the Secret Room!
Final.cutscene1.text5: You can complete the remaining achievements, collect a variety of hats to suit every taste, try solving puzzles, and finish all levels with three stars, and take on the gold cup challenges.

ui.intro.text1: Once, a family moved into a new house
ui.intro.text2: The family was filled with happiness and love, but an unexpected surprise awaited them!
ui.intro.text3: The children discovered a magical door that adults can't see
ui.intro.text4: The door to a world of mysteries and adventures was ready to open, inviting the young heroes to step into the unknown
ui.intro.text5: With a single touch, the entrance to the magical world was unlocked!
ui.intro.text6: The children stood at the threshold of the Secret Room — a world full of wonders
ui.intro.text7: It was like a magical whirlpool carried the children into the Secret Room.
ui.intro.text8: Inside the Secret Room, countless adventures awaited the children, and little Yasha became a true Rabbiman
ui.intro.text9: One day, the children set off on their usual adventures, but then...

Dania.interaction.text1: Do you love solving mysteries? I have a riddle that's even harder than finding the way out of the Secret Room!
Dania.interaction.text2: Are you looking for a challenge? How about a puzzle that even made my computer freeze?
Dania.interaction.text4: Hey, Yasha! Want to try solving a riddle that even the wise ones of the Secret Room considered unsolvable?
Dina.interaction.text1: Come visit me, Yasha! I have hats for every occasion – from a trip to the library to saving the world!
Dina.interaction.text2: Yasha, with a new hat, you'll be irresistible! Even mirrors will start applauding you!
Dina.interaction.text3: Come by, Yasha! Today we have hats with magical effects — put one on, and everyone around you will start smiling!
Dina.interaction.text4: Yasha, with a new hat, you'll be the king of style! Or at least the prince of fashion!
